user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking that does not exist to return a not-found error so that I know the ID is invalid.

negative.title: Retrieve a non-existent booking by using an invalid ID format
steps: Send a request to retrieve a booking with an ID that contains special characters, e.g., '#$%^&*'
Observe the response received from the server
negative.expected_result: The system should return a not-found error indicating the ID is invalid.

negative.title: Retrieve a booking using a numeric ID that does not exist
steps: Send a request to retrieve a booking with a numeric ID that is known to not exist, e.g., '999999'
Observe the response received from the server
negative.expected_result: The system should return a not-found error indicating the ID is invalid.

negative.title: Retrieve a booking using an empty ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve a booking with an empty string as the ID
Observe the response received from the server
negative.expected_result: The system should return a not-found error indicating the ID is invalid.

edge.title: Retrieve a booking using an extremely large numeric ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve a booking with a very large numeric ID, e.g., '999999999999999999999'
Observe the response received from the server
edge.expected_result: The system should return a not-found error indicating the ID is invalid.

edge.title: Retrieve a booking with a valid format but using a very long string as an ID
steps: Send a request to retrieve a booking with a string ID that exceeds the length limit, e.g., 'a' repeated 255 times
Observe the response received from the server
edge.expected_result: The system should return a not-found error indicating the ID is invalid.
